chunks: among us, how can you enjoy food and drink when you know that you are eating the unlawful and drinking the unlawful. You are purchasing slavemaids and wedding women with the money of the orphans, the poor, the believers and the participants in jihād to whom Allāh had dedicated this money and through whom He had strengthened these cities.
ai.seo_question: How did Imam Ali critique the misuse of public funds by officials?
ai.summary: Imam Ali (peace be upon him) critiques the official’s moral dissonance by linking his personal consumption to the misappropriation of *fay'* (public treasury) funds, which were divinely secured through the sacrifices of the believers. This passage underscores the Shia emphasis on accountability in governance, where leaders are held to a higher standard of justice regarding the rights of the vulnerable, such as orphans and the poor.

en.sayed-ali-raza: O’ you who were counted by us among the men possessed of mind,

how can you enjoy food and drink when you know that you are eating the unlawful and drinking the unlawful. You are purchasing slavemaids and wedding women with the money of the orphans, the poor, the believers and the participants in jihād to whom Allāh had dedicated this money and through whom He had strengthened these cities.
